LM19-02.name: The MakaiScythe Beelzebeat Scythe
LM19-02.effect:
[Brave Condition: Cost 4 or more
Purple & Grandwalker Nexuss] [During Spirit Brave] (When Attacks) Once per turn, you can summon a Cost 4 or less "Worldswalker"/"Celeste" family Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost. [During Nexus Brave] [Grand Field] (Your Main Step) By exhausting this Nexus, exhaust an opposing Grandwalker Nexus. When you've done so, all opposing exhausted Grandwalker Nexuses can't refresh until the next turn's Main Step, nor can they activate [Core Charge]/[Grand Skill].

LM19-05.name: The AngelicHolySpear Isfielance
LM19-05.effect:
[Brave Condition: Cost 5 or more
Yellow & Grandwalker Nexus]

[During Spirit Brave] (When Attacks)
During the Flash Timing, you can use one Magic card from your Hand without paying the cost. After its effect resolves, you can activate the same effect once and only once more.

[During Nexus Brave] [Grand Field] (Your Main Step)
By exhausting this Nexus, during this turn, while your Cost 6 or more "Divine Spirit" family Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't use cards from the Hand other than Yellow Magic cards.

LM19-03.name: The BladeKingBeastClaws Byak-Gaclaw
LM19-03.effect:
[Brave Condition: Cost 5 or more
Green & Grandwalker Nexuss]

[During Spirit Brave] (When Attacks)
Exhaust two opposing Spirits/Ultimates. When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, return two opposing exhausted Spirits/Ultimates to the Hand.

[During Nexus Brave] [Grand Field] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By exhausting an opposing Grandwalker Nexus, put a core from the Void to this Green-only Nexus.

LM19-06.name: The EmperorGrandSpear Alexander Spear
LM19-06.effect:
[Brave Condition: Cost 5 or more
Blue & Grandwalker Nexus]

[During Spirit Brave] (When Attacks)
If this Spirit has two Blue symbols or more, once per turn, by exhausting one of your Grandwalker Nexuses, refresh this Spirit.

[During Nexus Brave] [Grand Field] (Your Main Step)
By exhausting this Nexus, exhaust an opposing Grandwalker Nexus. During this turn, the opposing Grandwalker Nexus exhausted by this effect can't activate its [Grand Field].

LM19-01.name: The SuperstarDragonBlade Siegwurm Sword
LM19-01.effect:
[Brave Condition: Cost 4 or more
Red & Grandwalker Nexus] [During Spirit Brave] [Twinkle Clash] (When Attacks) Opposing Spirits/Ultimates must block if possible. When blocked, you can [Advent] a card from your Hand onto this Spirit, without sending [Soul Core] to the Trash. [During Nexus Brave] [Grand Field] Flash - (Your Attack Step) You can exhaust this Nexus. When you've done so, send the [Soul Core] from your Trash to any of your "Superstar" family Spirit and, during this turn, all your Spirits with [Soul Core] on it gain +5000 BP.

LM19-04.name: The WingDeityGun Grand Woden Blaster
LM19-04.effect:
[Brave Condition: Cost 4 or more
White & Grandwalker Nexuss] [During Spirit Brave] (Either Attack Step) Besides this Spirit, when your White-only "Worldswalker"/"Celeste" family Spirit is exhausted, this Spirit can refresh. [During Nexus Brave] [Grand Field] [GI Wall: Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue] (Opposing Turn) When the opponent uses a Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue Magic card, before its effect activates, by exhausting this Nexus, immediately negate that effect.
